entities.name: 2-Cyanobenzenesulfonyl chloride
observations: The scaffold is o-cyanobenzenesulfonyl chloride, represented as N#Cc1ccccc1S(=O)(=O)Cl.
The sulfonyl chloride is the electrophilic reactant; its S–Cl bond is replaced by an amine substituent.

entities.name: Dimethylamine
observations: Dimethylamine, represented as CN(C), is the nucleophile incorporated into the product.

entities.name: N,N-Dimethyl-2-cyanobenzenesulfonamide
observations: A valid canonical-style SMILES is CN(C)S(=O)(=O)c1ccccc1C#N; the equivalent orientation is N#Cc1ccccc1S(=O)(=O)N(C)C.

entities.name: Tertiary amine base
observations: The cyclic tertiary amine component is a base/spectator and is not incorporated into the principal product.

entities.name: Ethyl acetate
observations: Ethyl acetate is a medium or workup component and is not incorporated into the principal product.
